title: Case 009: Confirming the amount sent
initial_request: I remember entering £684.20 in the transfer draft, but the final payment line shows £648.20. Please confirm the amount H&V actually sent.
overview: Mara Ellwood queried the difference between the amount she remembered from a draft and the amount shown on her completed transfer to her property manager. After H&V completed its identification checks on a call, an agent checked the payment journal. It confirmed that H&V sent £648.20; the amount received by the recipient has not been established.

next_action.summary: Check the H&V payment journal against the final instruction for the completed transfer.

outcome: The H&V journal and secure portal confirm that £648.20 was sent. The amount received by the recipient is not established.

events.body: Final payment line: £648.20 sent to your property manager.

You’ve completed your identification checks. I remember the transfer draft as £684.20, but the final line shows £648.20. Please check the amount in the completed instruction; I’m not asking you to rely on my memory of the draft.
I’m checking the final instruction and execution record for Mara Ellwood’s completed property-manager transfer. Please confirm the amount H&V sent.
The final instruction and execution record show £648.20. H&V sent £648.20; this record does not establish the amount received by the recipient.
We checked the H&V payment journal: the amount sent was £648.20. The journal confirms the amount sent by H&V, not the amount received by the recipient.
